topic: Sharp comparison and exact combined pal-antipal length of zero-start Thue–Morse prefixes
title: A signed-weight extension of Frid's recurrence for the Thue–Morse prefix problems of Ambrož, Kadlec, Masáková and Pelantová

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Frid's ordinary-length recurrence (2019, Theorem 4), we prove the sharp factor-two and unbounded equal-cost assertions of Ambrož, Kadlec, Masáková and Pelantová, arXiv:1812.00711v2, Section 6, p. 13, final paragraph and Tables 1–2, p. 14, by identifying the combined pal-antipal length of each zero-start Thue–Morse prefix with the minimum weight of a signed binary expansion of its length. Desubstitution proves this formula and the sharp comparison with ordinary palindromic length. We determine all first equal-cost occurrences and the exact logarithmic upper growth rate of the combined length. Frid's recurrence also yields prefixes attaining the factor-two endpoint at every positive combined cost.
summary: C(n)=W(n) and C(n)<=P(n)<=2C(n), with both endpoints at every positive mixed cost. The first prefix with C(n)=k, also the first with P(n)=C(n)=k, has length (2*4^(k-1)+1)/3. The mixed prefix cost has limsup C(n)/ln(n)=1/ln(4) and liminf zero.

coverage.statement: For all n >= 1, P(n) <= 2C(n), and some n >= 1 satisfies P(n) = 2C(n) > 0.
coverage.support: Written proof; pinned sharp_factor_two_prefix declaration; exact finite word checks.

coverage.statement: For a_0 = 1 and a_(r+1) = 4a_r - 1, P(a_r) = C(a_r) = r+1.
coverage.support: Written proof; pinned family_attains and unbounded_equal_cost declarations; exact finite word checks.

additional_written_results: The first C(n)=k and the first P(n)=C(n)=k occur at (2*4^(k-1)+1)/3 for every k>=1
Nonempty palindromic prefixes have exactly lengths 4^r; antipalindromic prefixes exactly lengths 2*4^r, r>=0
P(64n+10) = P(n)+4 and C(64n+10) = C(n)+2, using Frid's ordinary recurrence
The arbitrary-factor extension is not asserted in the source; it fails for t[1:7)=110100, whose ordinary and mixed costs are 3 and 1
source_locator: arXiv:1812.00711v2, Section 6, p. 13, final paragraph; Tables 1 and 2, p. 14

declarations.sharp_factor_two_prefix: P(n)<=2C(n) for n>=1 and a positive attaining prefix

declarations.unbounded_equal_cost: For every K>=1 a positive prefix has C=P>=K
